description: This file contains unit test cases for the BasicWorkSchedule class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing methods related to employee work shift times and durations.

classes.name: BasicWorkScheduleTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing functionality of BasicWorkSchedule related to employee work shifts and scheduling.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Test retrieving the start and end time of an employee's work shift when EmployeeWorkShift data exists.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftStartEndTimeEmployeeWorkShiftEmpty
methods.description: Test fallback to default start and end times when no EmployeeWorkShift data is found for an employee.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Test calculation of the work shift length in hours for an employee.
